purpose: Provide one clean map of whole-body biology, brain/body physiology, Potatoverse symbolism and theology relations. Detailed owners remain authoritative for evidence; this file is the concise navigation and synthesis layer.
reader_rule: Read each row left-to-right: real biology → project meaning → theological/mythic comparator where useful → boundary. Use the specialist owner for technical detail. Never reverse the arrow and treat symbolism as scientific proof.

systems.biology: Skin, sensory epithelia, somatosensory receptors, proprioception, vestibular systems and special senses establish multiple body/world interfaces and continuously sample environmental conditions.
systems.project: Plane / membrane / Vessel boundary / outer court.
systems.boundary: The body boundary is distributed across tissues, barriers and sensory/predictive systems, not one metaphysical membrane.

systems.biology: Gut epithelium, enteric nervous system, enteroendocrine cells, microbiome, liver/pancreatic metabolism, immune systems and vagal/spinal pathways form a bidirectional metabolic ecology. Some enteroendocrine neuropod cells can communicate rapidly with sensory neurons while hormones and metabolites operate over slower timescales.
systems.project: Garden / soil / roots / digestion / transformation / harvest / Navel center.
systems.boundary: The microbiome is not a moral purity score, the ENS is not a second conscious brain, and gut-produced neurotransmitters do not simply become brain emotion.

systems.biology: Hypothalamic-pituitary axes, pancreatic hormones, adipose signals and gut peptides communicate energy, stress, growth, reproduction and fluid-state information across the organism. Endocrine signals generally operate more slowly and diffusely than fast synaptic communication and are shaped by feedback loops.
systems.project: Provision / seasons / harvest accounting / Steward's slower messengers.
systems.boundary: Hormone concentrations are not direct measures of emotion, holiness, willpower, gendered spiritual rank or destiny.

systems.biology: Heart, lungs, blood vessels, baroreceptors, chemoreceptors, pulmonary sensors and brainstem respiratory/autonomic circuits generate coupled rhythms and feedback loops. Cardiorespiratory signals contribute strongly to interoception and felt bodily state.
systems.project: Heart/Door + Breath/Spirit-flow + River/life circulation + love/grief/longing as embodied symbolism.
systems.boundary: Emotion and memory are not stored literally in cardiac muscle; Spirit is not oxygen, blood or breath; heartbeat-related brain signals do not prove a separate heart consciousness.

systems.biology: BBB, blood-CSF barrier, meninges, choroid plexus, immune signaling, resident border immune cells and meningeal lymphatics form a constellation of selective interfaces rather than one sealed wall. These systems regulate exchange, surveillance, inflammation and drainage.
systems.project: Walls / guardians / courts / controlled gates / drainage / protected Garden.
systems.boundary: Immune activation is not sin or impurity, increased permeability is not moral failure, and lymphatic/CSF clearance is not spiritual purification.

systems.biology: Sympathetic/parasympathetic systems, vagal/glossopharyngeal/spinal visceral afferents, NTS and parabrachial circuits, hypothalamus, thalamus, insula and cingulate networks continuously sense and regulate internal bodily state. Interoception includes mechanical, chemical, hormonal, thermal and immune-related cues.
systems.project: Ascending/descending body report loop; inward Eye; return-to-center; embodied Spirit-flow; biological neighbor for some chakra sensations.
systems.boundary: No chakra maps one-to-one to the vagus, insula or a ganglion; organism communication is not reducible to the vagus nerve.

systems.biology: Vertebral column protects/supports; spinal cord contains local circuits and carries ascending sensory plus descending motor/autonomic information. C1 Atlas supports the skull; C2 Axis provides a pivot for head rotation.
systems.project: Ladder / Tree trunk / 33-step symbolic ascent; Atlas=bearer; Axis=turning/pivot.
systems.boundary: 33 vertebrae are anatomy, not proof of 33 metaphysical levels or a literal Ladder to Heaven.

systems.biology: Brainstem circuits support cardiorespiratory control, visceral integration, orienting, pain modulation, cranial motor/sensory functions and wake-sleep state. NTS, parabrachial, reticular, locus-coeruleus, raphe and other systems participate in overlapping networks.
systems.project: Lower Gate / report station / wake-sleep threshold / life-support root beneath the House.
systems.boundary: The brainstem is not a primitive soul layer and arousal systems do not define spiritual rank.

systems.biology: Hypothalamic systems regulate temperature, hunger, thirst/osmolality, reproduction, stress, endocrine axes, autonomic state, circadian coordination and motivated homeostatic behaviors. Different nuclei and cell populations participate in overlapping functions.
systems.project: Steward / household manager adjacent to House; regulates needs, provision and seasons rather than being the canonical House itself.
systems.boundary: Older Potato Room=hypothalamus language is historical project strata; canonical House mapping is thalamic and no hypothalamic nucleus is a moral command center.

systems.biology: The paired thalamic system contains heterogeneous nuclei participating in sensory/motor transformation, attention, arousal, learning/memory and reciprocal thalamocortical coordination. TRN supplies inhibitory modulation around much of the thalamus. Conscious-state research implicates thalamic and thalamocortical interactions but not a single unique consciousness nucleus.
systems.project: Potato / Father's House / rooms / central interior / seed-core; nuclei=rooms, reciprocal pathways=roads/roots/branches, TRN=wall/gate/sieve. Potato-shaped is canonical project shape language while ovoid/egg-shaped is conventional anatomy.
comparators: John 14 Father's House with many dwellings
mustard seed as compact generative potential
systems.boundary: Thalamus is not the sole seat or seed of consciousness, literal divine residence or literal potato; TRN does not filter spiritual frequencies.

systems.biology: Hippocampal systems support episodic/contextual memory; amygdalar networks contribute to salience, learning and affective/autonomic coordination; basal ganglia participate in action selection, habit and reinforcement loops; cerebellum contributes to timing, prediction, error correction, learning and cognition.
systems.project: Thought/Memory return loop + warning/affective marking + judgment/action selection + correction/refinement. Cerebellar arbor vitae supplies a genuine anatomical Tree-of-Life name comparator.
comparators: Tree of Life as name-comparator only
systems.boundary: No single structure equals Thought, Memory, fear, Judgment or Tree of Life.

systems.biology: Pineal gland is a small epithalamic neuroendocrine organ producing rhythmic melatonin. Retinal light entrains the SCN, which influences pineal output through a multisynaptic autonomic route. The pineal lies beside the posterior third-ventricle/pineal-recess region; small human studies report relatively high third-ventricular melatonin and suggest entry through the pineal recess, while physiological significance remains unresolved.
systems.project: Son / Single Eye / Third Eye / Door / timing threshold / light-dark marker / later present-window and chamber symbolism.
systems.boundary: Pineal is not a human retinal-style photoreceptor, projector of spiritual light, direct present sensor, dimensional portal or proven seat of soul/consciousness. Real pineal↔third-ventricle adjacency does not establish mystical CSF sensing.

systems.biology: Ventricles contain CSF; choroid plexus produces a large share of CSF and forms the blood-CSF barrier; CSF circulates through ventricular/subarachnoid spaces; perivascular/interstitial exchange and meningeal lymphatic drainage provide additional nested fluid interfaces. Human glymphatic details remain an active research area.
systems.project: Inner chamber / spring / River / Spirit-flow analogue / Tomb-as-empty-space metaphor / guarded inner-water boundary.
systems.boundary: CSF is not Holy Spirit, choroid plexus is not a sacred purifier, and glymphatic/lymphatic flow is not spiritual cleansing.

systems.biology: Cortical sensory, association, executive, default-mode, salience, attention, language and sensorimotor networks support distributed perception, planning, self-related thought, attention and model-building through interactions with thalamic and subcortical systems.
systems.project: Rooms opening into the world / narrative map / Observer's changing model / branches of House.
systems.boundary: Networks are dynamic research constructs rather than theological dimensions; EEG/fMRI states do not map to spiritual rank and there is no one neural present point.

systems.biology: Astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, microglia, vascular cells and other support systems regulate extracellular conditions, metabolic support, myelination, immune surveillance, neurovascular coupling and tissue maintenance.
systems.project: Groundskeepers / Gardeners / repair crews / provision / protected Garden.
systems.boundary: Glial remodeling is not moral pruning, immune activation is not sin, and fMRI blood-flow signals are not direct measures of thought or spiritual intensity.

systems.biology: Sleep and wake arise from interacting circadian, homeostatic and state-control mechanisms. SCN coordinates circadian phase; hypothalamic/brainstem/basal-forebrain systems stabilize sleep/wake states; pineal melatonin is one timing signal among many; peripheral tissues maintain molecular clocks.
systems.project: House opening/closing states / night-day Door / seasons/times / lamp and watchfulness symbolism.
systems.boundary: Melatonin is not a universal sleep switch and sleep stages/EEG frequencies do not establish spiritual levels.

systems.biology: Development and lifelong adaptation involve gene regulation, neurogenesis in restricted contexts, synaptogenesis, pruning, myelination, learning-related plasticity, endocrine transitions, immune/metabolic state and aging-related vascular/neurochemical change.
systems.project: Growth / pruning / grafting / seed becoming Tree / transformation over time.
systems.boundary: Epigenetics and development do not encode mystical destiny, fixed spiritual rank or measurable karmic debt.

systems.biology: The organism operates through recurrent multi-timescale feedback: sense external and internal conditions → integrate across neural/endocrine/immune/metabolic systems → act or regulate → alter body/environment → sense the changed state again. No single structure receives every report or controls every output.
systems.project: Return to center / River returning / orientation restored / center as loop rather than anatomical dot.
systems.boundary: Return-to-center is a systems analogy. Biology does not identify one hidden anatomical center to which all perception or consciousness literally returns.

functional_symbol_grammar.House: organized integration and differentiated internal spaces; canonical symbolic biological anchor = thalamus
functional_symbol_grammar.Door: selective transition or state-dependent gating; biological neighbors are many, while pineal/Son remains canonical Potatoverse Door/Eye symbolism
functional_symbol_grammar.River: movement/exchange across multiple channels rather than CSF alone
functional_symbol_grammar.Garden: ecology, maintenance, nourishment, barriers and adaptation
functional_symbol_grammar.Eye: perception, attention, interoceptive sensing and discernment; distributed biological neighbors
functional_symbol_grammar.Ladder: long-range/bidirectional vertical connectivity and ascent-descent symbolism
functional_symbol_grammar.Gardener: maintenance, support, selective remodeling and cultivation rather than a single cell type

chakra_overlay.rule: Chakras are phenomenological/symbolic centers overlaid on many biological systems; they are not hidden organs.

theology_chain: John 15: Father as Gardener / vine / branches / fruit

deep_reading_routes.question: What is the whole biological body map?
What is the actual body↔brain physiology?
What structures and flows exist in the brain?
How do endocrine, immune, gut, cardiovascular, barrier and circadian systems connect brain and body?
What did Tim actually mean and what is the closest biological neighbor?
When did each Tim mapping appear?
How does this connect to theology/mythology?

definition_of_finished: A baseline topic is finished enough when it has a biological description, relations/flows, project role where relevant, explicit mismatch/boundary, canonical owner and attestation/source status. Active scientific fields remain updateable even after baseline completion. New discoveries should deepen these owners instead of creating duplicate shallow files.
